title: Which Simplest-Correct?
prompt:
**Scenario.** n ≤ 5000, you need the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray. You see Kadane O(n) instantly. The safest professional move is:

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Skip hand-tracing since Kadane is famous

**B)** Hand-trace Kadane on an all-negative array before coding

**C)** Code O(n^2) instead because it is safer

**D)** Binary search the answer first

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Kadane's famous pitfall is the all-negative array (must return the max element, not 0). The verification pass exists precisely for famous-but-tricky code.
